triggers.name: new_or_updated_object
triggers.title: New or updated object
triggers.description: New or updated object in Coupa
triggers.help: Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start recipe for the first time, it picks up trigger events from this specified date and time. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed.

input.name: return_object

actions.name: cancel_purchase_order
actions.title: Cancel purchase order
actions.help: Cancels the purchase order that matches the given ID.

actions.name: close_purchase_order
actions.title: Close purchase order
actions.help: Closes the purchase order that matches the given ID. Cancelled purchase order cannot be closed.

actions.name: create_attachment_on_object
actions.title: Add file attachment to object
actions.description: Add a file attachment in Coupa
actions.help: Add a file attachment to an object in Coupa. First, select the object or map a datapill to the field. Then, provide the internal Coupa ID of the object, the file contents as well as the name of the file. Handles files sizes of approximately 50MB.

input.name: object
input.label: Target object
input.hint: Select the object in which you need to create attachment for.

input.name: id
input.label: Coupa ID
input.hint: Enter the internal Coupa ID of the object you selected or map a datapill.

input.name: attachment_contents
input.label: Attachment contents
input.hint: The contents of the file to attach.

input.name: filename
input.label: Attachment name
input.hint: The name of the attachment with the file type. Example: Invoice.pdf .

input.name: intent
input.label: Intent
input.hint: The intent of the attachment. Example: Supplier .

actions.help: Attach a receipt file to an expense line using Coupa's expense artifacts API. The extension decides the content type, and only image extensions (for example .jpg, .png) are also sent as th…

input.label: Attachment contents
input.hint: The contents of the receipt file to attach. Map a file datapill; do not Base64-encode it.

input.name: filename
